title: How ATHENA turns a brief into a storyboard
counts: 8 LangGraph nodes, 14 node modules in total, 5 research tools.
source_note: Drawn from the project code (the LangGraph wiring and node modules). Entry routing is from reading the code, not from a live run. Team project.

intent_resolver.label: Intent resolver
intent_resolver.purpose: Reads the brief once with a single structured LLM call. It writes the Intent and the ExecutionPlan and classifies the entry type. It can pause to ask a clarifying question. On a re-run with an Intent already stored it is skipped, so the run is not reclassified.
intent_resolver.writes: Intent, ExecutionPlan, or a ClarificationRequest when it pauses

plan.label: ExecutionPlan
plan.purpose: Not an LLM supervisor. After the intent node, plain code reads the plan and picks the next node: the next node in the chain, or a jump straight to the scene pipeline when the remaining chain is skipped. Plan fields: needs_characters, needs_world, research_policy (always, never or auto), entry_point, skip_nodes, max_scenes, max_shots_per_scene.
plan.writes: Nothing; it routes. Routing, skip and resume are Built.

ideation.label: Ideation
ideation.purpose: Generates creative concepts from the Intent and picks one, with its rationale and the alternatives.

character_designer.label: Character designer
character_designer.purpose: Designs the characters from the Concept and Intent. Does nothing when the plan says needs_characters is false.

world_builder.label: World builder
world_builder.purpose: Builds the world: location, time period and ambiance. Does nothing when the plan says needs_world is false.

story_generator.label: Story generator
story_generator.purpose: Combines the Concept, characters, world and Intent into a story structured as beats.

scene_decomposer.label: Scene decomposer
scene_decomposer.purpose: Splits the story into ordered scene shells. Last node of the linear chain.

scene_pipeline.label: Scene pipeline
scene_pipeline.purpose: One graph node that is a plain Python loop. For every scene it runs the per-scene and per-shot modules in order. A failure in one scene is isolated from the others.
scene_pipeline.writes: Nothing itself; the modules inside write to each scene

project_assembler.label: Project assembler
project_assembler.purpose: Deterministic last node. Collects everything into the project output and writes the editable storyboard files.

video.label: Video generation from the storyboard
video.purpose: A possible next step that would turn the finished storyboard into video. It is not part of the graph and has not been built.

scene_researcher.label: Scene researcher
scene_researcher.purpose: Writes a research query for the scene and calls the research service. Skipped when research_policy is never or research already exists. A research failure does not stop the run.

script_writer.label: Script writer
script_writer.purpose: Drafts the scene script: narration, stage directions, dialogue, duration and emotional arc.

visual_director.label: Visual director
visual_director.purpose: Sets the look of the scene: subject, environment, lighting, colour and mood, and style.

shot_planner.label: Shot planner
shot_planner.purpose: Splits one scene into ordered shots with camera angle, framing and composition.

image_prompt_generator.label: Image prompt generator
image_prompt_generator.purpose: Builds the image prompt for one shot from the shot, the visual direction and the character identity.

image_generator.label: Image generator
image_generator.purpose: No LLM. Runs a moderation check, then calls the image model; if the model errors it tries a fallback model. If all fail it attaches a marked failed placeholder instead of stopping.
image_generator.note: Partial: a fix for silent empty images is not yet re-verified end to end.

scene_evaluator.label: Scene evaluator
scene_evaluator.purpose: Runs after all shots of the scene. Reports key concepts, understanding and issues as a signal; there is no repair loop.

web_search.label: Web search
web_search.what: Keyless web search by default, with fallback engines. Used by the research node and exposed by the MCP server.

fetch_page.label: Page fetch
fetch_page.what: Fetches a page and extracts readable text. Exposed by the MCP server only; the research node does not call it.

image_search.label: Image search
image_search.what: Finds reference images, including openly licensed ones, with their licence. Used by the research node and exposed by the MCP server.

youtube_search.label: YouTube search
youtube_search.what: Searches YouTube videos. Turned on only when an API key is set.

youtube_transcript.label: YouTube transcript
youtube_transcript.what: Gets the transcript of one video. Turned on only when an API key is set.

image_model.label: Image model
image_model.what: FLUX image model through NVIDIA NIM, set in the config. Partial: a fix for silent empty images is not yet re-verified end to end.

fallback_model.label: Fallback model
fallback_model.what: If the first image model errors, another FLUX model from a different family is tried before giving up with a placeholder.

entry_points.label: With scenes
entry_points.note: Same routing as with a script in the code.

entry_points.label: Visuals only
entry_points.note: Whether the visual director runs without a script was not verified.

entry_caption: Nodes whose output already exists are skipped, which is how runs resume.
